name: post-grid
title: Post grid
description: A hospital newsroom: tinted header band, nine photo cards with tag and date in a 3×3 grid, and a load-more button.
author: themes.dev

files.content:
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button" export type ImageRef = { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number } export type LinkRef = { label: string; href: string } export type Post = { title: string; tag: string; date: string; dateTime: string; cover: ImageRef; href: string } export type PostGridProps = { kicker: string title: string body: string link: LinkRef posts: Post[] more: LinkRef /** Under the button: how many posts there are. */ count: string } const cover = (name: string, alt: string): ImageRef => ({ src: `https://www.themes.dev/ui/photos/post-grid/${name}.webp`, alt, width: 760, height: 428, }) export const postGridDefaults: PostGridProps = { kicker: "Elmfield Hospital, Norwich", title: "News from the hospital", body: "What is changing on our wards and in our clinics, written for patients, visitors and the 3,400 people who work here.", link: { label: "Press enquiries", href: "#press" }, posts: [ { title: "Forty new volunteers join the welcome desk in the east atrium", tag: "Volunteering", date: "18 November 2026", dateTime: "2026-11-18", href: "#volunteers", cover: cover("volunteers", "Two volunteers in green tabards talk with an older patient at a hospital welcome desk."), }, { title: "Second MRI scanner cuts the wait for a scan to three weeks", tag: "Radiology", date: "12 November 2026", dateTime: "2026-11-12", href: "#mri", cover: cover("scanner", "A radiographer prepares a patient beside a white MRI scanner."), }, { title: "The courtyard garden reopens with step-free paths", tag: "Our site", date: "6 November 2026", dateTime: "2026-11-06", href: "#garden", cover: cover("garden", "A nurse and a patient in a wheelchair in a planted hospital courtyard."), }, { title: "Sixty-two nurses start on our wards after qualifying this autumn", tag: "Careers", date: "29 October 2026", dateTime: "2026-10-29", href: "#nurses", cover: cover("nurses", "Three newly qualified nurses in blue uniforms in a hospital corridor."), }, { title: "Collect your medicine on the day you go home, not the day after", tag: "Pharmacy", date: "22 October 2026", dateTime: "2026-10-22", href: "#pharmacy", cover: cover("pharmacy", "A pharmacist checks boxes of medicine on shelves in the hospital pharmacy."), }, { title: "Birth centre rated outstanding for the second year running", tag: "Maternity", date: "15 October 2026", dateTime: "2026-10-15", href: "#maternity", cover: cover("maternity", "A midwife shows a new mother how to hold her newborn."), }, { title: "Walking again sooner: the new rehabilitation gym on ward 9", tag: "Therapies", date: "8 October 2026", dateTime: "2026-10-08", href: "#rehab", cover: cover("physio", "A physiotherapist helps an older man walk between parallel bars."), }, { title: "Patient meals now cooked fresh on site, seven days a week", tag: "Our site", date: "1 October 2026", dateTime: "2026-10-01", href: "#kitchen", cover: cover("kitchen", "A hospital chef plates vegetable dishes in a stainless steel kitchen."), }, { title: "Three hundred covered bike spaces for staff and visitors", tag: "Travel", date: "24 September 2026", dateTime: "2026-09-24", href: "#bikes", cover: cover("bike", "A doctor locks a bicycle in a covered shelter outside the hospital."), }, ], more: { label: "Load more news", href: "?page=2" }, count: "Showing 9 of 146 stories", } export function PostGrid(props: Partial) { const c = { ...postGridDefaults, ...props } return (

{c.kicker}

{c.title}

{c.body}

{c.link.label}
    {c.posts.map((p, i) => (

  • {p.tag} · {p.date}

    {p.title}

    • ))}
{c.more.label}

{c.count}

) }
